title: Dataform Workflows Get Concurrency Control
summary: Dataform now allows developers to set a maximum concurrent actions limit for workflow invocations. A new `QUEUED` state for actions provides visibility into concurrency-related delays.
details: The `InvocationConfig` schema has been extended with an optional `concurrentActionsLimit` property (integer, `int32`). This allows you to specify the maximum number of actions that can run simultaneously within a workflow invocation. Additionally, the `WorkflowInvocationAction.state` enum now includes a `QUEUED` value, indicating that an action is awaiting an available concurrency slot. This enhancement provides finer control over resource utilization and better insights into workflow execution flow.
